content.text:
Wide shot, daytime, in a sunny backyard: LEO THE SQUIRREL (age 8, red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (age 7, pink dress, yellow bow) stand on a wooden ladder leading to a blue-and-orange treehouse; soft warm sunlight through leaves; cheerful storybook watercolor style; gentle mood; camera at eye level.

"Wow, Mia, our secret treehouse looks extra magical today," says Leo.

Medium-wide, daytime, interior of the cozy wood-walled treehouse: a round silver ELEVATOR DOOR with colorful buttons is set beside a small table holding a paper MAP and a brass MAGNIFYING GLASS; LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) face the door; golden light through a window; storybook watercolor; curious mood.

"Leo, look—there’s a hidden elevator right in our treehouse!" whispers Mia.

Close-up, daytime, inside the elevator: a shiny control panel with big glowing buttons labeled JUNGLE, DESERT, and CANDY MOUNTAINS; LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) stand side by side; soft interior lights; storybook watercolor; excited mood; camera tight on buttons and their paws.

"Let’s try the Jungle floor first," says Leo.

Wide shot, daytime, lush jungle clearing: broad green leaves, orange flowers, bright parrots on a branch, a sturdy VINE BRIDGE over a small stream, and a mango tree with ripe fruit; LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) stand at the bridge’s edge; dappled sunlight; storybook watercolor; adventurous mood; camera at eye level.

"The parrots are colorful, and I can smell sweet mangoes—let’s cross the vine bridge carefully," says Mia.

Medium shot, daytime, back inside the elevator: the control panel shows the DESERT button softly glowing; a tiny green fern leaf rests on the floor; LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) look toward the panel; warm cabin lights; storybook watercolor; anticipatory mood.

"Okay, next stop: the Desert floor," says Leo.

Wide shot, daytime, golden desert vista: rolling dunes, tall cacti, a small sparkling OASIS, a colorful pail and shovel, scattered seashells, and a half-built sandy mound; LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) stand beside the mound; clear blue sky; bright sun; storybook watercolor; playful mood; camera at eye level.

"Let’s build a sandcastle by the oasis and make a shiny shell the front door," says Mia.

Medium shot, daytime, inside the elevator again: the control panel shows the CANDY MOUNTAINS button glowing; Leo holds one clean seashell; LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) stand ready; soft cabin lighting; storybook watercolor; eager mood.

"Candy Mountains, here we come!" says Leo.

Wide establishing shot, daytime, candy mountain land: rolling sugar hills, lollipop trees, a chocolate river with gentle ripples, a rainbow candy tower, and peppermint stepping stones across a glossy path; LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) stand near the stepping stones; pastel light; storybook watercolor; wonder-filled mood.

"Let’s step only on the peppermint stones and imagine the rainbow tower is our castle," says Mia.

Medium-wide, daytime, at the base of the rainbow candy tower: a gumdrop path, a black licorice rope bridge, a tiny striped FLAG resting on a rock, and the chocolate river in the background; LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) stand by the flag; soft candy-colored light; storybook watercolor; joyful mood; camera at eye level.

"Let’s count the gumdrops to ten and wave our tiny flag for the castle," says Leo.

Medium-wide, late afternoon, inside the cozy wood-walled treehouse: the round silver ELEVATOR DOOR with colorful buttons, a small table with a scrapbook, crayons, glue, and the paper MAP; LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) stand by the table; warm golden light; storybook watercolor; calm mood.

"Back home—let’s draw everything we saw so we won’t forget," says Mia.

Close-up, late afternoon, treehouse table surface: open SCRAPBOOK pages, bright crayons, a glued seashell, and a sketch of parrots and a vine bridge; LEO THE SQUIRREL’S red cap edge and MIA THE RABBIT’S yellow bow peek into frame; warm window light; storybook watercolor; cozy mood.

"I’ll draw the jungle parrots while you add the mango tree," says Leo.

Medium shot, late afternoon, treehouse interior near the elevator: the control panel visible through the open door, buttons for JUNGLE, DESERT, CANDY MOUNTAINS; the scrapbook sits on the table, now with a desert sandcastle sketch; LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) stand between elevator and table; soft glow; storybook watercolor; thoughtful mood.

"And I’ll glue in a tiny sandcastle drawing with the shell door," says Mia.

Wide shot, late afternoon, candy-themed sketch page on the table: drawings of lollipop trees, peppermint stepping stones, and the rainbow candy tower; a small striped FLAG sticker lies beside the page; LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) visible behind the table; golden light; storybook watercolor; satisfied mood.

"This page needs the little flag—perfect for our candy castle," says Leo.

Medium-wide, early evening, treehouse interior: the round silver ELEVATOR DOOR, the table with closed scrapbook, the brass MAGNIFYING GLASS resting atop the MAP; LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) stand holding the scrapbook together; soft lamplight; storybook watercolor; peaceful mood.

"We visited three magical floors today—jungle, desert, and candy mountains," says Mia.

Close-up, early evening, elevator control panel: buttons softly glowing, with a small star sticker added near the CANDY MOUNTAINS button; the edges of Leo’s red cap and Mia’s yellow bow frame the panel; warm lamplight; storybook watercolor; dreamy mood.

"Let’s put a star sticker by every floor we explore," says Leo.

Medium shot, early evening, treehouse window view: dusky sky through leaves, the blue-and-orange treehouse walls, the table with the scrapbook and crayons neatly stacked; LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) stand near the window; soft twilight glow; storybook watercolor; gentle mood.

"I can’t wait to see where the elevator takes us tomorrow," says Mia.

Wide shot, early evening, cozy treehouse interior: the round silver ELEVATOR DOOR, the ladder hatch on the floor, the tidy table with the MAP, MAGNIFYING GLASS, closed SCRAPBOOK, and the seashell; LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) stand by the hatch; warm lamplight; storybook watercolor; snug mood.

"Let’s tuck our scrapbook safe and say goodnight to the elevator," says Leo.

Medium-wide, early evening, treehouse interior centered on the elevator door: colorful buttons glowing softly, a faint reflection of LEO THE SQUIRREL (red cap, blue shorts) and MIA THE RABBIT (pink dress, yellow bow) in the silver surface; gentle lamplight; storybook watercolor; tender mood; camera at eye level.

"Goodnight, secret elevator—thank you for the adventures," says Mia.
